# Second set of the document categories (#73)

Twelve household documents in French, written after the sentences of
`worker/src/worker/doccat.py` were set on the benchmark (`../bench/docs`), and
measured once without changing them: they tell how the categories hold on
documents they were not tuned on. `categories.toml` gives the expected
category of each.

**All are fictitious**: the people, companies, addresses and numbers are made up.
